title: Low Battery Guard
description: Stops a long upload, export, call or exam dying halfway on a flat battery: before it starts it compares the battery's runway (to a safety reserve, from the Battery Status API or a measured drain rate) with the task's length, draws where the battery would cut it off, and offers "Start when plugged in", which starts the task the moment a charger connects, staying silent when the task will finish anyway.
stops: Upload died on a flat battery
